item.title: TOMB RAIDER Set Photos: Sophie Turner's Lara Croft Battles The Rain, Joined By Martin Bobb-Semple's Zip
item.description: A new batch of set photos and videos from Prime Video's Tomb Raider show Sophie Turner's Lara Croft battling the elements, and joined by the fan-favorite Zip (played by Martin Bobb-Semple).

item.title: Long-Awaited BIOSHOCK Movie Gets Promising Update From Producer
item.description: Producer Roy Lee has hinted that work may soon begin on the long-awaited BioShock movie, which was first announced by Netflix in 2022.

item.title: HIGHGUARD Confirms Content Update This Week Amid Layoffs And Sinking Player Numbers
item.description: Wildlight Entertainment announced a new Highguard patch dropping later this week, adding the Cloudreach airship base, and new store items despite recent mass layoffs and a 98% Steam player count drop.

item.title: ARC RAIDERS: Embark Announces Player Punishments For Recent Exploits
item.description: Embark has concluded its investigation into recent exploits in Arc Raiders and is now set to enforce corrective actions, including possible account suspensions.

item.title: ARC RAIDERS Is About To Get Rocked By A New Hurricane Map Condition
item.description: The Arc Raiders weather forecast calls for a Hurricane to arrive on February 24. Here's everything you need to know about this brand new map condition and how it will impact your gameplay.

item.title: PATH OF EXILE 3.28 Mirage League Full Reveal Hits GGG Live Later This Week
item.description: Path of Exile's GGG Live streams February 26th on Twitch, unveiling the 3.28 Mirage expansion, challenge league mechanics, and more. The new league arrives early March on PC and consoles.

item.title: SLAY THE SPIRE 2 Latest Trailer Reveals New Characters, Co-op Mode And Early Access Date
item.description: Mega Crit's Slay the Spire 2 debuts in Steam Early Access in March as revealed in a stunning new trailer showcasing fresh heroes, environments, enemies, and a co-op option.

item.title: SOLO LEVELING: ARISE Launches FORTNITE Crossover With Rewards For Both Games
item.description: Solo Leveling: Arise dives into Fortnite till March 2nd with exclusive cosmetics for Sung Jinwoo, Cha Hae-In, Igris, and Kaisel. Valentine's Check-In events runs till mid March.

item.title: Valve Secures Major Legal Victory In Their Rothschild Patent Trolling Lawsuit
item.description: Valve just can't stop winning, they have taken another dub home after securing victory in their latest legal lawsuit over patent trolling from Leigh Rothschild.

item.title: MARATHON: Bungie Gives Details On Robust Anti-Cheat And Networking Ahead Of Free Server Slam This Week
item.description: Bungie's latest blog post talks about Marathon's dedicated servers, Fog of War system to combat wallhacks, BattlEye integration, and permanent bans for cheaters. The free Server Slam runs this weekend.
